provisioning.title: Provisioning
provisioning.empty: No sites or workspaces yet. Provision the first one to begin.
provisioning.error: Could not load the resource list. This is a failure asking the server, not a resource that failed.

authentication.emailHint: The code goes to exactly the address you type here.
authentication.confirmPasswordMismatch: Those two passwords do not match.
authentication.codeHint: The code is good for {minutes} minutes.
authentication.resentLabel: A new code is on its way.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Manage the systems you run on nivo.
signIn.refused: That email or password is not right.
signIn.twoFactorHint: This account has two-factor verification on. nivo does not support that step in this build — turn it off for now, or use another account.

signUp.title: Create a nivo account
signUp.subtitle: One account for every system you run and manage.
signUp.codeSubtitle: We have sent a 6-digit code to {email}.
signUp.codeRefused: That code is not right. Check it and try again — the old code still works.
signUp.emailTaken: That email already has an account. The code has been used, so sign in instead, or start again with another email.
signUp.doneHint: Your account is created and you are signed in.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: Enter your email and we will send a verification code.
forgotPassword.codeSubtitle: If {email} has an account, a 6-digit code has been sent to it.
forgotPassword.codeRefused: That code cannot be used. Check it, or start again from the beginning.
forgotPassword.doneHint: Your new password is saved. Sign in with it.
